title: C5 confirmatory selective structural execution with CASM-S
question: When the retained candidate set is reduced from H to K before structural execution, does the same CASM-S evaluator perform proportionally less measured structural work while preserving task capability?
hypothesis: For the controlled multi-valid equality benchmark, exact addressing should reduce the number of CASM-S graph executions from H to at most K without using hidden task truth in routing or addressing. The experiment measures the actual CASM-S execution work associated with the retained set; it does not establish semantic retrieval, learned addressing, or general C5.

bridge_training.loss: MSE between CASM-S output and exact relation result
bridge_training.purpose: integration calibration only; held-out task data are not used

arms.name: exhaustive
arms.intervention: execute every H candidate structure through the CASM-S evaluator

arms.name: exact-indexed
arms.intervention: content-address the candidate universe and execute only the retained K candidates

arms.name: representation-addressed
arms.intervention: retain the top-K candidates by fixed cosine similarity of public query bits and candidate descriptors
arms.note: fixed representation baseline, not a learned semantic-addressing claim

leakage_constraints: addressing receives only public query information and public candidate descriptors
CASM-S receives serialized graph structure and runtime input values only
true_edges are not serialized through the TAC-OSM transport
target, acceptable_actions and outcome are available only to post-execution evaluation
all arms use the same CASM-S model instance and evaluator

decision_rules.condition: exact-indexed success remains within the predeclared capability margin of exhaustive while structures_executed_per_query <= K
decision_rules.interpretation: the tested selective execution boundary preserves capability for this controlled benchmark and exposes the expected retained-set execution work
capability loss is observed under the tested retained-set budget; this does not imply selective execution is impossible

decision_rules.condition: measured CASM-S work does not scale with structures_executed
decision_rules.interpretation: the work model or batching implementation requires audit before any C5 interpretation

does_not_establish: generalization of CASM-S beyond the tested relevance-circuit family
system-wide latency scaling beyond the declared hardware and batch implementation
the full PLM economic-scaling claim C5
